alerts.headline: Alembic Pharma shares hit 20% upper circuit after strong Q2 results
alerts.summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals’ net profit surged 81.1 percent to Rs 335 crore in second quarter of FY27 from Rs 185 crore in the year-ago period.

alerts.headline: Zydus Lifesciences Q2 net profit falls 27% as expenses outpace revenue growth; shares decline 3.5%
alerts.summary: Total revenue rose 29.2% year-on-year to Rs 7,910 crore but expenses grew at a faster pace of 51%, including a 36.4% increase in R&D and 33.7% increase in employee benefits expenses

alerts.headline: US futures pare early losses to turn green as investors see limited impact of Democrat Sweep on earnings, growth
alerts.summary: Futures had fallen sharply earlier but recovered most of their losses, with Nasdaq futures rising up to 0.4 percent.

alerts.headline: Redington shares surge 11% on strong Q2 results; profit rises 21% to Rs 422 crore
alerts.summary: Redington’s consolidated profit after tax (PAT) reported an increase of 20.6 percent to Rs 422.5 crore in July-September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 350.2 crore posted a year earlier.

alerts.headline: Fractal Analytics shares rally 14% after Q2 net profit jumps 139% to Rs 79 crore
